map.📚 深度解析：IL-6 与炎症评估: Note: IL-6 is a key cytokine linking innate and adaptive immunity. IL-6 inhibitors (tocilizumab) block the IL-6 pathway, suppressing CRP/ESR acute-phase responses and Th17 differentiation and B-cell activation. CRP drops rapidly to normal (24-48h) on IL-6 inhibitors, but ESR declines slowly. Caution: IL-6 inhibitors can mask infection (CRP stays low); monitor for infection closely. Can cause neutropenia and transaminase elevation; active infection, diverticulitis/intestinal perforation risk are contraindications. For clinical reference only.
